rows.grounds: compound denoting the circular area of the breast

items.question: What shape and aesthetic quality must the breast-circle and breast be given in the prescribed form?
premises: The breast-circle is included in the prescribed shaping.
The breast itself is included in the prescribed shaping.
Both are to be made round and very beautiful.
items.inference: The prescribed iconographic form requires both the breast-circle and the breast to be rendered as round and highly beautiful.
uncertainties: The exact anatomical referent of stanākṣaṃ in this measurement context is not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: One should make the breast-circle and the breast round and very beautiful.
